en: I am Winona, the Leader of Fortree's Gym. I have lived among the trees and the wind all my life.
My Bird Pokémon and I have learned to ride the wind as one. Can you keep your feet when we come at you?
I have never seen anyone hold their ground so well against my birds. You fly higher than I thought.
This is the Feather Badge. Take it with my respect.
{player} received the Feather Badge from Winona!
With the Feather Badge, your Pokémon can use Fly outside of battle to carry you to any town you know.
And please, accept this as well.
TM40 holds Aerial Ace. It strikes so fast that it can never miss. A move worthy of the sky!
May I have your number? I would like to hear how high you fly from here.
TM40 holds Aerial Ace. It strikes so fast that it can never miss. A move worthy of the sky!
Even though I lost, my Pokémon and I will keep flying. The wind is always there to lift us again.
Yo, champ in the making! Winona flies Bird Pokémon, so Electric, Ice and Rock moves will serve you well.
The gates in here turn as you push through them. Mind which way you push, or you'll wall yourself in!
You beat Winona! You must have nerves of steel to stand up to that much wind.
